name: AlertDialog
description: A Material Design alert dialog. It typically contains a title, content, and a set of actions. Used to notify the user of situations that require acknowledgment or a decision.

properties.name: title
properties.description: The primary content of the dialog displayed in the title area.
properties.possible_values: Any widget, typically a Text widget.

properties.name: content
properties.description: The main content of the dialog, typically a Text or Column widget.

properties.name: contentTextStyle
properties.description: Text style for the content area.

properties.name: actions
properties.description: The set of actions at the bottom of the dialog (e.g., buttons).
properties.possible_values: List of widgets, typically TextButton or ElevatedButton.

properties.name: actionsOverflowDirection
properties.description: The direction in which action buttons should overflow.

properties.name: backgroundColor
properties.description: The background color of the dialog.

properties.name: elevation
properties.description: The z-coordinate of the dialog's material.

properties.name: scrollable
properties.description: Whether the content is scrollable if it overflows.

properties.name: clipBehavior
properties.description: How to clip content if it overflows the dialog's boundary.

properties.name: insetPadding
properties.description: Padding applied to the dialog to prevent it from growing too large.
